scope: Local application and synthetic MCP/Workers; no live account calls or deployment

checks.name: Packaged task skill quick validation and changed prose/whitespace review

acceptance_evidence: Neutral v1/v2 hashes remain unchanged; three v3 fixtures match C# and TypeScript for setting, clearing and combined game detail fields.
Default recurrence keys remain absent from legacy application serialization and normalized Worker commands.
Application commands roundtrip schedules, preserve unspecified fields/history and reject wrong kinds, invalid rules and linked/pending/uncertain projection edits.
Scheduled completion rejects unmatched dates; original command duplication adds no second event. Clearing restores unscheduled completion without erasing past history.
Portable journal validation rejects recurrence intents with fabricated game effects, missing snapshots and contradictory accepted rules without requiring historical timezone availability.
Actual local MCP SDK advertises recurrence, reviews/accepts one Daily, reads/reuses original completion receipts and clears the schedule.
Synthetic MCP workflow records zero upstream writes and denies another profile access to the receipt.
limitations: The basic PWA editor still creates unscheduled Dailies and has no recurrence authoring controls. UI work remains behind E01.
Pause/skip/restart, habit review, agenda and saved views remain separate Pending work.
Actual client/packaged-skill discovery, mobile behavior and live qualification remain unrun.
Older clients can reject extended command fields; coordinated release precedes use of v3 intents.
